ruleDefinitions.name: Windows Defender Exclusion Registry Key - Write Access Requested
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects write access requests to the Windows Defender exclusions registry keys. This could be an indication of an attacker trying to request a handle or access the object to write new exclusions in order to bypass security.
 Note: Unmapped fields: AccessList, ObjectName

sequences.query: ((AccessList = RGX(".*\\%\\%4417.*") OR AccessList = RGX(".*\\%\\%4418.*")) AND (event_id = 4656 OR event_id = 4663) AND ObjectName = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\\\Exclusions\\\\.*"))
